# Slid Phi Labs
> Small computation lab in Cherry Hill. Tools that check: same result or refuse; sealed or not open; signed or not trusted; measured or not claimed.
> https://www.slidphilabs.com/

## Who
Slid Phi Labs. Corey Tasz. Human door: /humans  Agent door: /agents  Inbox: corey@slidphilabs.com

## Products
- CuNi — language. One source → Python, Go, JS or refuse. $0. https://www.slidphilabs.com/cuni  Studio: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/
- Chamber — two-key protocol for storing a JSON secret. License to cloak $9/mo · $99/yr. Open existing seals with both keys (no extra payment). Try 24h: /box. https://www.slidphilabs.com/chamber
- Agent-Rider — signed agent identity L0–L4. $79/mo · $790/yr. Ops (heartbeat) $29/mo · $290/yr. https://www.slidphilabs.com/rider  App: https://agentrider.fly.dev/
- AWARE — hosted lossless compressor (engine: Combined GC). $9/day · $49/mo · $490/yr. Access, not source. TRU8/Gate/ZRW are names inside this stack, not extra SKUs. https://www.slidphilabs.com/gc
- Suite — metered AWARE jobs. 6.9 GB / 3 h unpaid, then ~5¢/GB. https://www.slidphilabs.com/pps
- Lab Pass — Chamber year license + AWARE + TruGame, $668/yr. Not Rider. https://www.slidphilabs.com/lab-pass
- Quikgater — pay-per-fact fetch for agents (x402). Not a seat. https://www.slidphilabs.com/quikgater
- Consulting — $250 / 2 hours. https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay?sku=consulting
- pulsar — public GPLv3 demo compressor. Not Combined GC. https://github.com/ceedot-rock/pulsar-best
